app.name: Scholia
conversation.moveHint: A conversation moves only to a project protected at the same level or more. Its history moves with it; what it spent stays where it was spent.
conversation.noTargets: There is no other project to move it to.
conversation.deleteBody: Its messages are deleted. What it spent stays in its project's spending.
conversation.emptyTitle: What would you like to work on?
conversation.emptyBody: Ask a question, or describe what you need. Scholia answers in this conversation and remembers where you left off.
conversation.loadFailed: This conversation could not be loaded.
composer.label: Message
composer.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
turn.revoked: The project changed during this run.
turn.limit: This conversation reached its budget. Raise it in Settings, then continue.
turn.unsaved: This answer was shown but could not be saved.
panel.libraryEmpty: Your papers and files will appear here.
setup.intro: A research assistant for reading, thinking and writing. It uses AI models through OpenRouter, with your own key.
setup.keyHelp: How do I get a key?
setup.otherProviders: Other providers can be added later in Settings.
setup.storeWarning: Your system's key store was unavailable, so the key is kept in a private file in Scholia's data folder.
settings.title: Settings
settings.backgroundRunsHint: Work Scholia does after an answer, such as titling a conversation.
settings.noRuns: Nothing has run in the background yet.
settings.dataFolderHint: Scholia keeps its database, files and settings here, readable only by your account.
folder.label: Folder
dataFolder.missing: Scholia was set to use a folder that is not there now. If it is on a disk that is not connected, connect the disk and open Scholia again, or choose another place.
dataFolder.chooseHint: Choose an empty folder on this Mac that does not sync to the cloud. To keep your work, first close Scholia and move the old data folder there in Finder.
dataFolder.chosen: Scholia will use this folder from the next time it opens. Close Scholia and open it again.
project.deleteBody: Its conversations, files and settings are deleted, with everything recorded about them.
delete.retention: Deleted data can stay in Scholia's automatic backups for about five weeks (7 daily and 4 weekly backups). Delete everywhere removes it from them now.
delete.removeAllTraceHint: Scholia keeps a record that something was deleted, with its title. With this, the record keeps no title either.
delete.purgeFailed: It was deleted, but the older backups could not be cleared of it. They drop it as they are replaced, within about five weeks.
backups.title: Backups
backups.hint: Scholia backs up its database and settings once a day and keeps 7 daily and 4 weekly backups in its data folder. They hold no files; a full backup does.
backups.fullHint: The database, your files and your settings, never your keys, in one zip file in a folder you choose. Keep it on another disk.
backups.passphraseHint: Needed when a project is Private or Local only: the file is encrypted with it. Scholia cannot recover a lost passphrase.
backups.fromFileHint: A zip file a full backup wrote. Its files are added to Scholia's.
backups.passphraseRestoreHint: Only if the backup is encrypted.
backups.restoreBody: Scholia first saves its current state as a backup, stops any running work, then puts this backup in place. Anything done since is replaced; restore the saved copy to go back.
backups.restored: Restored. Scholia is running on the backup.

backups.missingFiles.one: {count} file it refers to is missing.
backups.missingFiles.other: {count} files it refers to are missing.

backups.damagedBody: Scholia has not changed it. Restore a backup to continue; the damaged file is kept with the backups.
export.title: Export this project
export.hint: Its conversations as Markdown, its records as JSON, its files and its settings, never your keys, in one zip file anyone can open.
export.passphraseHint: This project is Private or Local only, so its export is encrypted with this passphrase. Scholia cannot recover a lost passphrase.
errors.passphrase_required: A passphrase is needed: it holds a Private or Local only project, or it is encrypted.
errors.wrong_passphrase: The passphrase does not open this backup.
errors.backup_busy: Settings kept changing during the backup. Try again.
errors.database_damaged: Scholia's database is damaged. Restore a backup.
errors.database_unavailable: Scholia's database is not open right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.backup_failed: The backup could not be taken, so nothing else was done.
errors.write_failed: The file could not be written.
errors.destination_not_writable: Scholia cannot write to that folder. Choose another.
errors.destination_in_data_folder: Choose a folder outside Scholia's data folder.
errors.invalid_destination: Choose the folder by its full path.
errors.not_a_backup: That file is not a Scholia backup.
errors.backup_unreadable: That backup could not be read.
errors.newer_schema: That backup comes from a newer version of Scholia. Update Scholia to restore it.
errors.restore_failed: The backup could not be put in place. Nothing was changed.
errors.safety_copy_failed: Scholia could not first save its current state, so nothing was restored.
errors.data_folder_problem: Scholia has not opened its data folder.
errors.data_folder_synced: That folder syncs to the cloud or is on a network drive.
errors.data_folder_not_empty: Choose an empty folder, or one that already holds Scholia's data.
errors.data_folder_not_found: The folder that would hold it does not exist.
errors.data_folder_unsafe: Another account on this Mac could change that folder.
errors.data_folder_invalid: That folder cannot be used. Choose a folder by its full path.
dataFolder.title: Scholia cannot use its data folder
dataFolder.synced: The data folder is inside a folder that syncs to the cloud or sits on a network drive, where its database could be damaged.
dataFolder.unsafe: Another account on this Mac could change what the data folder holds, so Scholia will not open it.
errors.unreachable: Scholia's engine is not responding. Close Scholia and open it again.
errors.active_run: This conversation is still working. Wait for it, or stop it.
errors.model_needed: Choose a model for this provider in Settings.
errors.no_provider: No model provider is set up yet.
errors.provider_key_missing: The provider has no key. Add it in Settings.
errors.unknown_provider: That provider is not set up.
errors.invalid_request: Something in the form is not valid.
errors.settings_changed: The settings changed meanwhile. Try again.
errors.conversation_moved: The conversation moved to another project. Send again.
errors.less_strict_project: A conversation can move only to a project protected at the same level or more.
errors.key_not_saved: The key could not be saved.
errors.general_project: The General project cannot be deleted.
errors.session_required: This page is not Scholia's own window.
errors.network: The provider could not be reached.
errors.timeout: The provider took too long to answer.
errors.quota: The provider's account has run out of credit.
errors.rate_limit: The provider is limiting requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.malformed: The provider's answer could not be read.
errors.refused: This request is not allowed for this project.
errors.save_failed: The answer could not be saved.
errors.cancelled: The message was stopped before it was sent.
errors.invalid_effort: That effort level is not available.
errors.not_continuable: Only the latest stopped or interrupted answer can be continued.
